content.text:
Did you mean **_The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night, Volume V_** translated by **John Payne**, or **_The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night, Volume V_** translated by **Richard F. Burton**?

If you’re looking for **Volume V online**:

- **John Payne translation** — _The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night_ is available on Wikisource; it’s the earlier unexpurgated English translation, originally published in 9 volumes in 1882–1884. ([en.wikisource.org](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Book_of_the_Thousand_Nights_and_One_Night?utm_source=openai))
- **Richard F. Burton translation, Volume 5 of 10** — _The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night — Volume 05_ is available at Project Gutenberg. ([gutenberg.org](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/54257?utm_source=openai))

If you want, I can also provide a **summary of Volume V**, a **table of contents**, or help you find the **full public-domain text**.
